title: BETA Errands MCP Server Tools
description: Errand tools for elderly care: paying bills, reordering medicines, scheduling appointments, and checking utilities in India.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Retrieve household profile details: parent name, guardian name, spending limits, and emergency frozen status.

tools.name: list_billers
tools.description: Retrieve registered utility billers (electricity, water, broadband) for the household.

tools.name: list_payees
tools.description: Retrieve saved payees, pharmacies, and merchants registered for the household.

tools.name: list_meds
tools.description: Retrieve registered chronic prescription medications, dosage instructions, and refill costs.

tools.name: get_due_bills
tools.description: Retrieve all pending unpaid utility bills (e.g., BESCOM electricity ₹1,240 due 28 Nov).

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: Find available doctor and clinic appointment slots in Dharwad / Hubli.

date.description: Target date in YYYY-MM-DD format or 'tomorrow'.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a clinic appointment for the parent, creating a Google Calendar event and digital confirmation receipt.

slot_iso.description: Appointment start time in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Schedule a reminder in Google Calendar and persist in household reminders.

time_iso.description: Target reminder time in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: pay_bill
tools.description: Pay an electricity, water, gas, or broadband bill for the elderly household through approved billers/payees via BBPS gateway.

payee_id.description: Payee or biller identifier, e.g. 'BESCOM' or 'BWSSB'.

amount.description: Bill amount in INR to pay.

idem_key.description: Unique idempotency key for preventing duplicate charges.

assessment_id.description: Telemetry voice assessment identifier validating lack of coercion.

approval_id.description: Optional guardian authorization ID if transaction exceeds auto_limit.

note.description: Optional contextual note or spoken reason from parent.

payee_known.description: Security Fact: True if payee is pre-registered on household whitelist.

hour_ist.description: Security Fact: Current hour in Asia/Kolkata timezone (0-23).

payments_last_hour.description: Security Fact: Number of payments executed in the last 60 minutes.

approval_valid.description: Security Fact: True if valid non-expired guardian approval exists and cooling-off elapsed.

scam_flag.description: Security Fact: True if coercion keywords or R4 risk level detected.

frozen.description: Security Fact: True if household emergency freeze is engaged.

assessment_valid.description: Security Fact: True if fresh (<300s), unused assessment without R4 risk exists.

tools.name: reorder_medicine
tools.description: Order chronic monthly medications from verified neighborhood pharmacies with Cedar guardrail enforcement.

med_ids.description: List of medicine IDs to refill, e.g. ['METFORMIN_500MG', 'AMLODIPINE_5MG'].

approval_id.description: Guardian approval ID if amount exceeds auto_limit.

note.description: Optional voice reason spoken by parent.

pharmacy_name.description: Pharmacy merchant name (defaults to Apollo Pharmacy).

hour_ist.description: Security Fact: Current hour in IST.

tools.name: check_bill_status
tools.description: Check current due amounts and payment status for utility providers (BESCOM, BWSSB, etc.).

biller_id.description: Optional biller ID (e.g. 'BESCOM') to query single provider. If omitted, returns all pending bills.

tools.name: list_saved_billers
tools.description: Retrieve the list of registered utility billers, accounts, and saved pharmacies for the household.

tools.name: reorder_medicines
tools.description: Order chronic monthly medications from verified neighborhood pharmacies (legacy alias).
